qualification: Digest corpus is derived from restricted original GPU evidence, not hardcoded or printed. Text path/credential/email matches are candidates and require contextual classification; binary Git commit metadata remains separately disclosed. Per-view bytes and recursion depth are bounded; unsupported formats, excluded symlinks, unknown roots, encodings or credentials are not cleared. Git administrative metadata and history are omitted; the scan covers the specified working tree only. No product code is executed.
